arguments.sql:
SELECT T2."XCL_018"
FROM district AS T2
INNER JOIN account AS T1 ON T2."XCL_017" = T1."XCL_002"
INNER JOIN loan AS T3 ON T1."XCL_001" = T3."XCL_034"
WHERE T3."XCL_039" = 'A'
  AND T2."XCL_027" BETWEEN 8000 AND 9000
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM client AS T4
    WHERE T4."XCL_012" = T2."XCL_017"
      AND T4."XCL_010" = 'F'
      AND T4."XCL_011" < '1950-01-01'
  )
GROUP BY T2."XCL_017", T2."XCL_018"
ORDER BY SUM(T3."XCL_036") DESC
LIMIT 1
